buyers_l30d.description: Buyers Active L30D (online) - distinct CUSTOMER_CODE per account
buyers_l30d.sql: SELECT c.company_name, c.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_code) AS buyers_online_l30d FROM SALE_DETAILS sd JOIN COMPANIES c JOIN CUSTOMERS cu WHERE ks_flag=TRUE AND sales_channel IN ('eCommerce','K2K','API') AND shipping_date >= DATEADD(DAY,-30,CURRENT_DATE) AND sales < 100000 GROUP BY company_name, account_id ORDER BY buyers_online_l30d DESC

aov.description: AOV (Average Order Value) online per account, H1 2026
aov.sql: SELECT COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, SUM(SALES) as total_online_gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT SALE_ITEM_ID) as total_orders, SUM(SALES)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT SALE_ITEM_ID),0) as aov_online FROM SALES_SV WHERE KS_FLAG=TRUE AND SHIPPING_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND SHIPPING_DATE < '2026-07-01' AND SALES < 100000 AND SALES_CHANNEL IN ('eCommerce','K2K','API') GROUP BY COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID HAVING total_online_gmv > 0 ORDER BY total_online_gmv DESC
aov.note: SALES_SV may have customer fan-out per Rule 5. AOV and GMV totals are directional, not deduplicated. For precise company GMV use DISTINCT sale_item_id dedup.

vendors.description: Vendors active vs total per account, H1 2026 (all procurement channels)
vendors.sql: SELECT c.company_name, c.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pd.total_cost > 0 THEN v.vendor_name END) AS vendors_active, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vendor_name) AS vendors_total FROM PROCUREMENT_DETAILS pd JOIN COMPANIES c JOIN VENDORS v WHERE ks_flag=TRUE AND shipping_date >= '2026-01-01' AND shipping_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY company_name, account_id ORDER BY vendors_total DESC
